name: Cross-Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - 2.*
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
      - 2.*

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

        - go: '1.22'

          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    steps:

        with:

          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'

        go:

          - '1.23'

        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

        shell: bash

        run: |

          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'

          - '1.23'

        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars

          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"

          go env

          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'

        go:

        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:

        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:

          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment

          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env

jobs:
  build:

      matrix:
        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

        - go: '1.22'

          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

on:

      - master

    branches:

jobs:
  build:

        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

name: Cross-Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - 2.*
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
      - 2.*

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

on:

    branches:
      - master

jobs:

        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

To set up the Caddy server (caddyserver-caddy-6669) from source code in a fresh Docker container and run its test suite, follow these guidelines:

1. **Dockerfile Structure**: Create a Dockerfile that clones the Caddy repository, sets the working directory, and installs necessary dependencies. Ensure you structure the Dockerfile as follows:
   ```
   FROM golang:1.20-alpine  # Adjust the base image based on the project's language and dependencies

   # Install git first, separately from other packages
   RUN apk add --no-cache git

   # Install other relevant packages for building
   RUN apk add --no-cache gcc musl-dev

   WORKDIR /app

   # Clone the Caddy repository
   RUN git clone https://github.com/caddyserver/caddy.git

   WORKDIR /app/caddy/cmd/caddy

   # Build Caddy
   RUN go build -o caddy

   CMD ["/bin/sh"]
   ```

2. **Mandatory Notes**:
   - Do not add '|| exit 0' to commands you run directly on the Linux terminal. Only add it to RUN instructions within the Dockerfile.
   - You are not allowed to use Docker commands in the terminal tool, meaning commands like: "docker something..." are prohibited.

3. **Post-Container Launch**:
   Once the Docker container has been launched:
   - Install required system packages and language runtimes as specified in the documentation.
   - Install any language-specific dependencies (e.g., using `go get` for Go) as indicated in the Caddy documentation to ensure all necessary modules are available.
   - Run any setup or migration scripts manually inside the container, referring to project_config or other config files as necessary.

4. **Reminder for Dependency Management**:
   - Always include a command to install git in the Dockerfile, ensuring it gets its own line to prevent installation failures if other packages cause `apk` to fail.

5. **Testing**:
   - After building, you may run tests using the command:
     ```
     go test ./...
     ```
   - This command will run all tests in the current package and its sub-packages.

6. **Additional Considerations**:
   - The information provided might not be exhaustive or entirely accurate. It is advisable to cross-check the setup instructions against the official documentation or other reliable sources to ensure all necessary steps are accounted for and to adapt for any specific project requirements.
   - If any errors arise during the installation or testing process, consult the GitHub issues page for the repository or the Caddy community for potential solutions or workarounds. 

7. **Variations**:
   - Depending on the specific plugins or configurations you wish to use, you may need to modify the build commands or Docker setup to incorporate additional dependencies or settings.
   - For example, to build with specific plugins using `xcaddy`, you might adjust the build command in your Dockerfile as follows:
     ```
     RUN xcaddy build --with github.com/caddyserver/nginx-adapter
     ```
   - Ensure you check the compatibility of plugins with the Caddy version you are using. 

By following these guidelines, you can successfully set up and run the Caddy server from source code within a Docker container.

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:

      - name: Install Go

        with:

          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment

          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

        continue-on-error: true

jobs:

        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

        run: |

name: Cross-Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - 2.*
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
      - 2.*

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

on:

    branches:
      - master

    branches:

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

          - 'freebsd'

        - go: '1.22'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

on:

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:

      matrix:
        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build

          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build

          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

name: Cross-Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - 2.*
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
      - 2.*

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

name: Cross-Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - 2.*
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
      - 2.*

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

name: Cross-Build

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - 2.*
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master
      - 2.*

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

    steps:

          - 'aix'

          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'

        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

        - go: '1.22'

          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    steps:

        with:

      - name: Print Go version and environment

on:

    branches:
      - master

    branches:

jobs:
  build:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

on:

jobs:
  build:

        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

        run: |

          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null

          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'

        - go: '1.22'

          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:

          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment

          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'

        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go:

          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build

          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true

        run: |

    steps:

on:

    branches:
      - master

jobs:
  build:

        goos: 
          - 'aix'
          - 'linux'
          - 'solaris'
          - 'illumos'
          - 'dragonfly'
          - 'freebsd'
          - 'openbsd'
          - 'windows'
          - 'darwin'
          - 'netbsd'
        go: 
          - '1.22'
          - '1.23'

        include:
        # Set the minimum Go patch version for the given Go minor
        # Usable via ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
        - go: '1.22'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.22.3'

        - go: '1.23'
          GO_SEMVER: '~1.23.0'

    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    continue-on-error: true
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Install Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.GO_SEMVER }}
          check-latest: true

      - name: Print Go version and environment
        id: vars
        run: |
          printf "Using go at: $(which go)\n"
          printf "Go version: $(go version)\n"
          printf "\n\nGo environment:\n\n"
          go env
          printf "\n\nSystem environment:\n\n"
          env

      - name: Run Build
        env:
          CGO_ENABLED: 0
          GOOS: ${{ matrix.goos }}
          GOARCH: ${{ matrix.goos == 'aix' && 'ppc64' || 'amd64' }}
        shell: bash
        continue-on-error: true
        working-directory: ./cmd/caddy
        run: |
          GOOS=$GOOS GOARCH=$GOARCH go build -tags=nobadger,nomysql,nopgx -trimpath -o caddy-"$GOOS"-$GOARCH 2> /dev/null
